rulings.found: Around that same time, Jesus Mary Chain brought out their first single. So those things were all kind of pulling towards that.
rulings.citation: Kevin Shields told Mixdown (2024) that The Jesus and Mary Chain's first single, along with Einstürzende Neubauten's live show, was among the things pulling My Bloody Valentine towards their early direction, though he called the idea of a shared Cocteau Twins and Jesus and Mary Chain influence "garbage" and named Psychocandy as the one shared record.
rulings.why: Shields names the first single as one of the things pulling the band toward their direction, though he hedges; a close call.

rulings.found: But Branca was NOT a musical influence," he clarifies, " more an ideal of what it's possible to achieve through sound.
rulings.citation: Michael Gira told The Wire (via Young God Records) that playing under Glenn Branca was an inspiration, but that Branca was not a musical influence, more an ideal of what sound could achieve.
rulings.why: Gira explicitly says not a musical influence while calling Branca an inspiration, so a contested denial; could be kept at first-person inspiration if the owner prefers.
